name: 完了操作付き設定シート見出し
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: Japanese Lighthouse component catalog design candidate, LH07-0001 完了操作付き設定シート見出し.
Primary request: Render exactly ONE compact settings-sheet header component with its two Japanese text elements, redesigned in our official white and forest-green system. It is a header strip, not a full settings screen.
Input images: Image 1 is our saved FigCraft mock: preserve its content, centered title, right-side completion action, reading order and compact proportions. Image 2 is original source evidence: ONLY the Settings / Done header region is relevant (normalized x0,y70,w390,h55); all other rows and phone chrome are outside this component. Image 3 is the approved style reference for white surfaces, soft elevation and forest-green gradient craft only; copy none of its bus/map text, icons or layout.
Composition: a single front-facing white rounded header strip on a pure #FFFFFF canvas, approximately 390 logical px wide and 56 logical px tall, enlarged uniformly for readable output. Use a wide image around 1536x512 with restrained white breathing room. Keep 設定 centered in the full strip. Keep 完了 at the right with usable inset, on a compact forest-green gradient pill. Balance the left empty region so the title remains truly centered. Do not introduce extra labels, icons, back arrows, phone, status bar, setting rows or explanatory text.
Text (verbatim, the only text): center title 設定; right action 完了.
Typography: preserve Meiryo Bold for 設定 and Meiryo Regular for 完了, existing logical 14px / 24px line height, tracking 0. Uniformly enlarge with the header, never make all text bold. Japanese glyphs must be exact and sharp.
Surfaces: pure-white header and outer canvas, fine neutral outline and restrained downward soft shadow, gentle rounded corners appropriate to a small toolbar. Forest-green action gradient #174C36 to #1F6444 to #2D8F5E, with legible white 完了 and subtle edge light; no gloss bands. Main title #1D1D1D.
Accent decision: original blue Done means the primary completion action. Adapt that role to forest green; no separate blue accent is needed in this two-element header. Remove the mock's broad mint fill. No decorative colors.
Constraints: preserve the two controls' exact content, hierarchy and visible default state; no invented feature or content; flat orthographic UI render, no perspective, no environment, no watermark. This image is a visual candidate only.
reviewNotes: 原画面全体・対象見出し比較・保存モックを目視確認。原版の青いDoneは終了操作の強調であり、完了ボタンのみ森緑グラデーションへ適応。mint全面色を白へ修正。生成画像の設定・完了、中央見出し、右ボタン、余白、白面、穏やかな影を目視確認。追加の行やアイコンなし。フォント実体・操作・ネイティブ編集・所有者承認は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
